name: extrude-l-section
description: An L-shaped profile extruded 25 mm. Concave deliberately: a re-entrant corner is the standard way to make a face that a later feature splits, and it exercises ear-clipping triangulation rather than a fan. Six side walls plus two caps, each side wall traceable back to the profile edge that swept it -- which is the provenance the whole naming layer rests on.
